title: Triage Lite allows a write outside spec posture

rule.title: Triage Lite is read-only
rule.message: Triage Lite is a read-only workflow.
rule.what: A write tool was called during triage.
rule.cause: The triage-lite workflow reports findings; it does not change files.
rule.why: Triage runs in the spec posture, where the project tree stays untouched.
rule.fix: Record the finding in your write-up, then leave triage before editing.
rule.instead: Branch on Code TRIAGE_LITE_WRITE_FORBIDDEN and report instead of writing
